title: Christ the Last Adam
definition: Christ the Last Adam means that Jesus is the representative head of a new humanity who succeeds where Adam failed.
summary: Jesus is the Last Adam who brings life where the first Adam brought sin and death.
christFocus: Christ represents His people in righteousness, obedience, resurrection, and new creation life.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Adam's sin brought guilt, corruption, and death to humanity. Christ comes as the Last Adam, the obedient representative who brings righteousness and life.

Where Adam disobeyed, Christ obeyed. Where Adam's sin brought death, Christ's resurrection brings life.

This doctrine shows the representative work of Christ and the beginning of new creation in Him.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: People often think of sin and salvation only individually. Christ the Last Adam matters because it shows that believers receive a new identity and future in a new representative.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Do not define yourself only by Adam's fall or your past sin. In Christ, receive new life and walk as part of the new humanity He is forming.
